# `Clock`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\Clock`

**Interface** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/Clock.php#L16) — **Version:** working tree

**Implemented by:** [`Runner\MonotonicClock`](/api/classes/Runner/MonotonicClock)

Monotonic time source behind the per-run deadline and the phase budget.

The seam exists so deadline/budget behaviour can be characterised
deterministically (a fake clock advances by exact amounts) instead of by
sleeping; production code always uses [`Runner\MonotonicClock`](/api/classes/Runner/MonotonicClock).

## Methods

### nanoseconds()

```php
nanoseconds(): int
```

Current reading of a monotonic clock, in nanoseconds. Only differences
between two readings are meaningful.
